summary: List claims by kind or subject prefix through GET /v1/claims and fractal claims ls

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes; the reads use the existing claims kind, subject and subject-kind indexes.

rules.detail: No authority or policy rule changes; the listing keeps hiding reserved subjects and kinds.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/claims accepts optional kind and subject_prefix parameters; subject with subject_prefix is refused with invalid-claims-query. Requests without them and the response shape are unchanged. Adds the read-only fractal claims ls command, which accepts optional --as read attribution like other operational reads.
